data.name: Blight
data.description: This spell withers a single plant of any size. An affected plant creature takes 1d6 points of damage per level [maximum 15d6] and may attempt a Fortitude saving throw for half damage. A plant that isn't a creature doesn't receive a save and immediately withers and dies. This spell has no effect on the soil or surrounding plant life.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
